title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: A goal for each player
hook: Does each of your players have their own goal?
intro: The team goal is to win.
One player just wants to get a hit.
statement: Personal goals give every kid a way to succeed.
q1: Do you set a small goal with each player —
q2: or keep the focus on team goals?
q3: What would each player choose for themselves?
t1: There is no single right way. But every kid can win
t2: when they have a goal that is theirs.
cta: Coaches — do you set personal goals?
ctaLines: One goal each. Check in monthly. Team goals only.
ctaPrompt: Share your goal habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Does each of your players have their own goal?
The team goal is to win. One player just wants to get a hit.
Personal goals give every kid a way to succeed.
Personal goals or team goals. There is no single right way.
Do you set personal goals? Share your habit in the comments.
